rows.title: A closure without the record could recur: T3 was reopened from a vacuous closure that had no baseline, contract or review
rows.body: The tr3 review recorded the condition; this closure closes it with the record — charter, scope baseline, schedule and cost baselines, the live delivery contract, the Phase-G review and the published closure review — not with a waiver. The risk is that a future closure is taken on prose.
rows.response: The closure gate refuses without the record; the tr4 review reads this register.

rows.title: The five accepted deliverables are T3's complete scope; the project owns no open items
rows.body: The closure review records no open item owned by T3. The B3 benefit profile's dependency on T6's approved baseline is a T6 dependency, recorded on the programme benefit evaluation.

rows.title: The B3 benefit profile waits on T6's approved baseline; the tranche-4 review reads it
rows.body: T3's closure does not depend on it; the programme's benefit evaluation does.
